result:
I updated `src/exports/links.ts`. `DownloadLink` now has `expiresAt: string`, set to 7 days after creation as an ISO timestamp. The URL now includes it as `&expires=<url-encoded expiresAt>`. I haven't run or tested it.

This change only puts the expiry in the link. Nothing here rejects an expired link, so the download side has to check `expires` for the links to actually stop working. The `expires` value is also plain text in the URL, so a client could edit it unless the server signs it or checks it against its own record.
